html:
The main international airport of South Korea, opened in March 2001 on land reclaimed from the sea between two islands west of Incheon, about 50 km from Seoul.

It replaced the crowded Gimpo Airport for international flights and was built to make Korea a hub between China, Japan and the rest of the world. It opened in time for the 2002 FIFA World Cup, which Korea hosted with Japan. A long bridge and an airport railway link it to the city.

It became one of the busiest airports in Asia for passengers and cargo and the base of Korean Air. For years it was rated among the best airports in the world for service.

Like the Gyeongbu Expressway a generation earlier, it is a piece of infrastructure built to carry the growth of South Korea.
sum: The main international airport of South Korea, opened in March 2001 on land reclaimed from the sea between two islands west of Incheon, about 50 km from Seoul.
